title: Summer Breeze - Vacation Rental in Rosemary Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… "Summer Breeze," a gorgeous Rosemary Beach condo perfect for up to 6 guests. Overlooking St. Augustine Green, you'll sip your coffee on the private patio furnished with al fresco dining for four. Just 3 minutes from the Cabana Pool and a short 4-minute bike ride to sugar-white sand beaches, this stunning 1st floor condo offers stylish interiors and plenty of charm. You'll also be steps from the town's shops and eateries and all 4 Rosemary Beach pools. Learn more below… 👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***3-Minute Walk to the Cabana Pool4-Minute Bike Ride to the Beach3 Beach Bikes Included with the Stay to Explore 30ACozy Patio with Al Fresco Dining for 4Sleeps 6 Comfortably in 2 Bedrooms/2 Full BathsSteps to St. Augustine Green for Family Picnics and GamesAccess to All 4 Rosemary Beach PoolsEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"Great place in walking distance to all major restaurants and shops in Rosemary! Super clean and stylish." – Laura J.⭐"The location could not be beat. This condo was gorgeous, included all we could need and more!" – Erin G.⭐"Great for the kids! Biking to the beach and playing wiffle ball on the green space made this the perfect stay for our family." – Brandy P.*** LIVING AREAS ***The heart of "Summer Breeze" lies in its open-concept living and dining room, where elegant interiors meet casual comfort. Kick back on plush seating while enjoying movie nights on the flat-screen TV. Natural light streams in from floor-to-ceiling windows, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere.Spacious Living Room with Plush Sofa and ArmchairsFlat-Screen TV for Movie NightsFloor-to-Ceiling Windows Bringing in Natural Light*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The fully equipped kitchen ensures meal prep is a breeze! With a dining table that seats 6 and additional bar seating for 2, you’ll have plenty of space to dine together or enjoy a casual coffee chat.Fully Equipped Kitchen with Modern AppliancesDining Table Comfortably Seating 6 GuestsBreakfast Bar with Seating for 2*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Rest easy in "Summer Breeze," where serene and stylish bedrooms offer a restful escape after a day in the Florida sun.Primary Queen Suite: Queen-Sized Bed, En-suite Bath with Walk-In Shower and Dual VanitiesQueen Guest Suite: Queen-Sized Bed + Built-In Twin-Over-Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 4)Hallway Bathroom: Tub/Shower Combination and Single Vanity*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***"Summer Breeze" guests enjoy exclusive access to everything Rosemary Beach offers. Walk to the Cabana Pool just a minute away or explore nearby parks, shops, and restaurants. Stroll the cobblestone streets to discover charming boutiques or sink your feet into the sugar-white sand of some of the world's most beautiful beaches. The emerald water creates a stunning backdrop for family photos, while gorgeous sunsets set the stage for relaxing evenings. With 2.3 miles of footpaths and lush green fields perfect for family time, every moment here becomes unforgettable.St. Augustine Green (Less than 50 Steps Away)Cabana Pool (3-Minute Walk)Rosemary Beach Shops & Restaurants (3-Minute Walk)Rosemary Beach (4-Minute Bike Ride)5-Min Walk to Heated Sky Pool & Fitness CenterRacquet Club – One of the World’s Top 75 Tennis SpotsRosemary Beach Community: Beachside Destination with Award-Winning ArchitectureMultiple Parks & Greens: Playgrounds, Splash Pad, Butterfly Park, Boardwalks, and Fountains4 RESORT POOLS:Barbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 3 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 221900
